Setup instructions

Follow the practical guide

Original installation instructions

  1. Codex CLI route: Review the repository; run npx skills add LottieFiles/motion-design-skill and select your host and project scope.
  2. In Codex invoke $motion-design for one transition. Expect a timing/easing plan and reduced-motion behavior.
Check before keeping it

Ask for one small result, inspect the output and permissions, and confirm it suits your app. If it fails, undo your changes and return to your original project.
